pages.title: Bulk Processing
pages.text:
**Bulk processing** (fan processing) is what an Encased Fan does to items in its air, on the ground, a belt or a depot.\
\
The block the air passes through decides it: washing, smoking, blasting, haunting and add-on types. Fan speed only changes the range.
